Name: Spouses in Ginger Island
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3][size=4][u][b]English[/b][/u][/size]

This mod allows vanilla spouses to visit the island, with schedules unique to their personalities.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Configurable chance per day of going[/size]
[*][size=3]Children can go to the island[/size]
[*][size=3]Choose which spouses go[/size]
[*][size=3]Invite them for a day, or a week! (Tickets avaiable in fish shop)[/size]
[*][size=3]Mod spouses will have a randomized schedule (unless a custom one is provided- see below.)
[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod is[b] compatible with SVE, freelove, immersive spouses, and child2npc[/b]- along with a few others. [b]Compatible with content patcher.[/b]

If you like what i do, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mistyspring][b]consider buying me a coffee [/b][b]♥.[/b][/url]


[size=4][u][b]Español[/b][/u][/size]

Este mod permite que tu pareja (e hijos) visite(n) la isla- viene con rutinas integradas. También ofrece un personaje que cuidará de tus bebés si les tienes.
 
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Probabilidad diaria configurable[/size]
[*][size=3]Tus hijos pueden ir también[/size]
[*][size=3]Escoge qué parejas irán[/size]
[*][size=3]Invítales por un día, o ¡Por una semana! (tickets disponibles en tienda del pescador).[/size]
[*][size=3]Las parejas de mods tendrán rutinas aleatorias (a menos que se agregue una propia- ver al final).
[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]C[/b][b]ompatible con SVE, freelove, immersive spouses, y child2npc[/b]- entre otros.[b] Compatible con content patcher.[/b]


Si te gustan mis mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mistyspring][b]considera apoyarme en ko-fi [/b][b]♥.[color=rgb(97, 97, 97)][color=#ffffff]
[/color][/color][/b][/url]
[b][color=rgb(97, 97, 97)][color=#ffffff]


[size=4][u]Content patcher (How-to)[/u][/size][/color][/color][/b]

You'll need to know how [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Schedule_data]patching schedules[/url] works.

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Add an entry called "IslandVisit" to their schedule.
[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) If you want to randomize where they go, use "Custom_Random 0 0 0" as location.
[/size]
[/list][size=3]That's it![/size] [size=3]For a more detailed guide, [url=https://github.com/misty-spring/SpousesIsland/blob/main/docs/custom_spouse.md]see here.[/url]

[size=4][u][b]Content patcher (cómo editar)[/b][/u][/size]

Tendrás que saber cómo[url=https://es.stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Datos_de_horarios] editar rutinas de personaje.[/url]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Agrega una rutina llamada "IslandVisit" a su archivo.
[/size]
[*][size=3](Opcional) Si quieres que vaya a un lugar aleatorio, usa "Custom_Random 0 0 0" como lugar.[/size]

[/list][size=3]¡Eso es todo! Si necesitas un ejemplo mejor, [url=https://github.com/misty-spring/SpousesIsland/blob/main/README-es.md]ve aquí.[/url][/size]
